+
+                    if (targetType.split(DASH_SEPARATOR).length > 0 && !context.getJsonArray("topology.filter.targets").isEmpty())
+                    {
+                        var targets = context.getJsonArray("topology.filter.targets");
+
+                        switch (NMSConstants.TopologyFilterType.valueOfName(context.getString("topology.filter.target.type").split(DASH_SEPARATOR)[1]))
+                        {
+                            case IP_ADDRESS -> targets.forEach(target -> filters.add(CommonUtil.getString(target)));
+
+                            case IP_ADDRESS_RANGE ->
+                            {
+                                for (var index = 0; index < targets.size(); index++)
+                                {
+                                    var range = targets.getString(index);
+
+                                    var start = range.split("-")[0].trim();
+
+                                    var end = start.substring(0, start.lastIndexOf('.')) + "." + range.split("-")[1].trim();
+
+                                    if (APIUtil.validateRange(start, end))
+                                    {
+                                        CommonUtil.calculateIPRange(InetAddress.getByName(start), InetAddress.getByName(end)).forEach(ip -> filters.add(CommonUtil.getString(ip)));
+                                    }
+                                }
+                            }
+
+                            case GROUP -> ObjectConfigStore.getStore().getItemsByGroups(targets).forEach(id -> filters.add(ObjectConfigStore.getStore().getItem(CommonUtil.getLong(id)).getString(OBJECT_IP, EMPTY_VALUE)));
+
+                            case TAG -> ObjectConfigStore.getStore().getObjectIdsByTags(targets).forEach(id -> filters.add(ObjectConfigStore.getStore().getItemByObjectId(CommonUtil.getInteger(id)).getString(OBJECT_IP, EMPTY_VALUE)));
+
+                            default ->
+                            {
+                            }
+                        }
+
+                        event.put("topology.filter.target.type", targetType);
+                    }
+                }
+                catch (Exception exception)
+                {
+                    LOGGER.error(exception);
+                }
+            }
+        }
+

+    private Future<Void> cloneTemplateWidgets(JsonObject template)
+    {
+        Promise<Void> promise = Promise.promise();
+        try
+        {
+
+            if (!template.containsKey("template.widgets"))
+            {
+                promise.complete(null);
+
+                return Future.succeededFuture();
+            }
+
+            var templateWidgets = template.getJsonArray("template.widgets");
+
+            if (templateWidgets.isEmpty())
+            {

+
+                promise.complete();
+
+                return Future.succeededFuture();
+            }
+
+            var futures = new ArrayList<Future<Void>>();
+
+            LOGGER.info("Starting to clone " + templateWidgets.size() + " widgets");
+
+
+            for (var i = 0; i < templateWidgets.size(); i++)
+            {
+                var item = templateWidgets.getJsonObject(i);
+
+                if (item.containsKey(ID))

+

+                                }
+                            });
+                        }
+                        else

+                            LOGGER.info(asyncResult.cause().getMessage());
+
+                            widgetPromise.fail(asyncResult.cause());
+                        }
+                    });

+            }
+
+

+

+
+            return promise.future();
+        }

+            LOGGER.error(exception);
+
+            promise.fail(String.format(INTERNAL_SERVER_EXCEPTION, exception.getMessage()));

+            if (templateWidgets.isEmpty())

+                LOGGER.debug("Empty widgets array for template");
+
+                promise.complete();
+
+                return Future.succeededFuture();
+            }
+
+            var futures = new ArrayList<Future<Void>>();
+
+            LOGGER.info("Starting to clone " + templateWidgets.size() + " widgets");
+
+
+            for (var i = 0; i < templateWidgets.size(); i++)

+

+     * @param duration : elapsed time since cycle start
+     * @return burn rate as multiplier (e.g., 1.5 means 1.5x burn rate)
+     */
+    private static float getSLOBurnRate(JsonObject data, JsonObject cycle, float targetPercentage, long duration)
+    {

+            if (duration <= 0)

+            }

+            }

+            // Calculate burn rate

+ * in the Motadata event bus architecture. It provides a standardized abstraction
+ * layer that allows different transport protocols (ZMQ, TCP, UDP) to be used
+ * interchangeably without affecting the application logic.

+ *

+ *

+ *

+ * // Create and configure transport client

+ *     // Process received message

+ * }).onFailure(error -> {

/*
*   Runbook Variables
*
*   udp.port = 515                                                      --> Port to forward the logs
*   interval = 5 (unit: minutes)                                        --> Collect Logs which are 5 minutes earlier than the current time
*   log-name = Security,System,Application  (Multiple with , seperated) --> Category or source of the event log
*   event-id = 4672                                                     --> Unique numerical identifier assigned to a specific type of event
*   severity = [LogAlways, Critical, Error, Warning, Informational]     --> Indicates the seriousness or impact of the event
*   provider-name = Microsoft-Windows-Security-Auditing                 --> Name of the source or the component
 */
func run(result motadatatypes.MotadataMap, context motadatatypes.MotadataMap) {
	client := &winrmclient.WinRMClient{}

	client.GetConnection(context)

	result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusFail

	var errors []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap

	port := 515 // Default UDP log collector listener port

	eventSource := fmt.Sprintf("%-15s", context.GetStringValue(consts.ObjectIP)) // will append event source at starting from the message

	if context.Contains(consts.RunbookPluginVariables) {
		variable := context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables)

		if variable.Contains("udp.port") {
			port = variable.GetIntValue("udp.port")
		}
	}

	socket, err := net.Dial("udp", "127.0.0.1:"+strconv.Itoa(port))

	if err != nil {
		errors = append(errors, motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{
			consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeConnectionFailed,
			consts.Message:   err.Error(),
		})

	} else {
		defer cleanUp(client, result, socket)

		command := buildCommand(context)

		if client.Init() {
			output := client.ExecuteCommand(command)

			if output.IsNotEmpty() {
				timezone := getTimeZone(client)

				for _, token := range output.Split(consts.NewLineRegexPattern + consts.NewLineRegexPattern) {
					splittedTokens := token.Split(consts.NewLineRegexPattern)

					event := make(motadatatypes.MotadataMap)

					event["id"] = getValue(splittedTokens[0])
					event["provider"] = getValue(splittedTokens[1])
					event["level"] = getValue(splittedTokens[2])
					event["level-description"] = getValue(splittedTokens[3])
					event["source"] = getValue(splittedTokens[4])

					index := 5

					message := motadatatypes.MotadataString(consts.BlankString)

					for ; ; index++ {
						if splittedTokens[index].Contains("TimeCreated") {
							break
						}

						if index == 5 {
							message += getValue(splittedTokens[index])
						} else {
							message += " " + splittedTokens[index].TrimSpace().ReplaceAll("\t", " ")
						}
					}

					event["message"] = message

					event["timestamp"] = splittedTokens[index].SplitN(":", 2)[1].TrimSpace() //cannot be blank

					index++

					event["audit"] = getValue(splittedTokens[index]).ReplaceAll("{", "").ReplaceAll("}", "")

					index++

					event["task"] = getValue(splittedTokens[index])

					if timezone.IsNotEmpty() {
						event["timezone"] = timezone
					}

					_, err = socket.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", eventSource, event.ToJSON())))
				}

				result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusSucceed

			} else {
				errors = append(errors, motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{
					consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeNoItemFound,
					consts.Message:   "No log(s) found for specified time",
				})
			}
		}

		if len(client.GetErrors()) > 0 || len(errors) > 0 {
			errors = append(errors, client.GetErrors()...)
			result[consts.Errors] = errors
			result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusFail
		}
	}
}

func buildCommand(context motadatatypes.MotadataMap) motadatatypes.MotadataString {
	command := motadatatypes.MotadataString("[System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture='en-US';[System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture='en-US';Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{")

	interval := 5

	maxEvents := 1000 //windows client is taking too much time is we don't declare any limit to it

	if context.Contains(consts.RunbookPluginVariables) && context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables).IsNotEmpty() {
		variables := context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables)

		if variables.Contains("log-name") {
			command += "logname="

			command += splitFields(variables.GetMotadataStringValue("log-name")) + ";"
		} else {
			command += "logname="

			command += "'System','Security','Application';"
		}

		if variables.Contains("event-id") {
			command += "id="

			command += splitFields(variables.GetMotadataStringValue("event-id")) + ";"
		}

		if variables.Contains("severity") {
			command += "level="

			command += motadatatypes.MotadataString(getSeverity(variables.GetStringValue("severity"))) + ";"
		}

		if variables.Contains("provider-name") {
			command += "providername="

			command += splitFields(variables.GetMotadataStringValue("provider-name")) + ";"
		}

		if variables.Contains("interval") {
			interval = variables.GetIntValue("interval")
		}
	} else {
		command += "logname="

		command += "'System','Security','Application';"
	}

	command += "starttime="

	duration := time.Now().Add(-time.Duration(interval) * time.Minute)

	command += "'" + motadatatypes.MotadataString(duration.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05.000")) + "';"

	command += "} -MaxEvents " + motadatatypes.MotadataString(strconv.Itoa(maxEvents)) + " | format-list -property id,providername,level,leveldisplayname,logname,message,TimeCreated,keywordsDisplaynames,taskdisplayname"

	return command
}

func cleanUp(client *winrmclient.WinRMClient, result motadatatypes.MotadataMap, conn net.Conn) {
	if r := recover(); r != nil {
		result[consts.Errors] = []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{
			{
				consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeInternalError,
				consts.Message:   "Invalid Result",
				consts.Error:     fmt.Sprintf("%v", r),
			},
		}
	}

	client.Destroy()

	err := conn.Close()

	if err != nil {
		result[consts.Errors] = []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{
			{
				consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeInternalError,
				consts.Error:     err.Error(),
			},
		}
	}
}

func getSeverity(value string) string {
	severity := "0"

	switch value {
	case "LogAlways":
		severity = "0"
	case "Critical":
		severity = "1"
	case "Error":
		severity = "2"
	case "Warning":
		severity = "3"
	case "Informational":
		severity = "4"
	}

	return severity
}

func getValue(value motadatatypes.MotadataString) motadatatypes.MotadataString {
	if len(value.Split(":")) > 1 {
		return value.Split(":")[1].TrimSpace()
	}

	return consts.BlankString
}

func splitFields(token motadatatypes.MotadataString) motadatatypes.MotadataString {
	result := ""

	if token.Contains(",") {
		for _, value := range token.Split(",") {
			if value.IsNotEmpty() {
				result += "'" + string(value.TrimSpace()) + "'" + ","
			}
		}
		result = strings.TrimRight(result, ",")
	} else {
		result += "'" + string(token.TrimSpace()) + "'"
	}

	return motadatatypes.MotadataString(result)
}

func getTimeZone(client *winrmclient.WinRMClient) motadatatypes.MotadataString {
	timezone := client.ExecuteCommand("[Regex]::Replace([System.TimeZoneInfo]::Local.BaseUtcOffset, '(\\d+:\\d+)', '$1')")

	if timezone.IsNotEmpty() {
		if timezone.HasPrefix("-") {
			return timezone.TrimSpace()
		} else {
			return "+" + timezone.TrimSpace()
		}
	} else {
		return consts.BlankString
	}

/*
*   Runbook Variables
*
*   udp.port = 515                                                      --> Port to forward the logs
*   interval = 5 (unit: minutes)                                        --> Collect Logs which are 5 minutes earlier than the current time
 */
func run(result motadatatypes.MotadataMap, context motadatatypes.MotadataMap) {

	client := &vmwareclient.VMWareClient{}

	client.GetConnection(context)

	result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusFail

	var errors []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap

	port := 515 // Default UDP log collector listener port

	eventSource := fmt.Sprintf("%-15s", context.GetStringValue(consts.ObjectIP)) // will append event source at starting from the message

	if context.Contains(consts.RunbookPluginVariables) {

		variable := context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables)

		if variable.Contains("udp.port") {

			port = variable.GetIntValue("udp.port")
		}
	}

	socket, err := net.Dial("udp", "127.0.0.1:"+strconv.Itoa(port))

	if err != nil {

		errors = append(errors, motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{

			consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeConnectionFailed,
			consts.Message:   err.Error(),
		})

	} else {

		defer cleanUp(client, result, socket)

		ctx, cancel := contextlib.WithTimeout(contextlib.Background(), time.Second*time.Duration(context.GetIntValue(consts.Timeout)))

		defer cancel()

		if client.Init() {

			taskList, err := retrieveTasks(client, context, ctx)

			if err == nil && len(taskList) > 0 {

				for _, token := range taskList {

					event := make(motadatatypes.MotadataMap)

					event["vm.name"] = token.EntityName

					event["status"] = token.State

					event["complete.time"] = token.CompleteTime.String()

					event["start.time"] = token.StartTime.String()

					event["name"] = token.Name

					if strings.Contains(reflect.TypeOf(token.Reason).String(), "TaskReasonUser") {

						event["user.name"] = token.Reason.(*types.TaskReasonUser).UserName

					}

					if token.Description != nil {

						event["description"] = token.Description.Message

					} else {

						event["description"] = token.DescriptionId
					}

					// Parse the start and end times to calculate execution time
					startTime, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02 15:04:05.999999999 -0700 MST", event["start.time"].(string))

					// consider task start time as a timestamp and convert into seconds
					event["timestamp"] = startTime.Unix()

					if err != nil {
						loggerObj.Info("Failed to parse task start.time")
					}

					endTime, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02 15:04:05.999999999 -0700 MST", event["complete.time"].(string))

					if err != nil {
						loggerObj.Info("Failed to parse task complete.time")
					}

					event["execution.time.ms"] = endTime.Sub(startTime).Milliseconds()

					_, err = socket.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", eventSource, event.ToJSON())))

					if err != nil {

						loggerObj.Info(motadatatypes.MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("Failed to send Log! %v", err.Error())))
					}

				}

				result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusSucceed

			}

			// in case of No log(s) found for specified time
			if len(taskList) == 0 && err == nil {

				loggerObj.Info("No log(s) found for specified time")

				result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusSucceed

			} else if err != nil {

				errors = append(errors, err...)
			}
		}

		if len(client.GetErrors()) > 0 || len(errors) > 0 {

			loggerObj.Info(motadatatypes.MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("Errors : %v", errors)))

			errors = append(errors, client.GetErrors()...)

			result[consts.Errors] = errors

			result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusFail
		}
	}

}

func retrieveTasks(client *vmwareclient.VMWareClient, context motadatatypes.MotadataMap, ctx contextlib.Context) ([]types.TaskInfo, []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap) {

	var errors []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap

	taskManager := task.NewManager(client.GetClient().Client)

	interval := 5

	if context.Contains(consts.RunbookPluginVariables) && context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables).IsNotEmpty() {

		variables := context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables)

		if variables.Contains("interval") {

			interval = variables.GetIntValue("interval")
		}
	}

	startTime := time.Now().Add(-time.Duration(interval) * time.Minute)

	// Set up task filter specifications
	filter := types.TaskFilterSpec{Time: &types.TaskFilterSpecByTime{BeginTime: &startTime, TimeType: types.TaskFilterSpecTimeOption("startedTime")}}

	tasks, err := taskManager.CreateCollectorForTasks(ctx, filter)

	if err != nil {
		errors = append(errors, motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{

			consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeInternalError,
			consts.Message:   "Error while creating collector, Failed to retrieve tasks!",
			consts.Error:     fmt.Sprintf("%v", err.Error()),
		})
	}

	var tasksList []types.TaskInfo

	for {

		page, err := tasks.ReadNextTasks(ctx, 100) // fetch in batches of 100

		if err != nil {

			loggerObj.Info(motadatatypes.MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("Failed to retrive tasks! %v", err.Error())))
		}

		if len(page) == 0 {

			break // exit if no more tasks
		}

		tasksList = append(tasksList, page...)

	}
	return tasksList, errors
}

func cleanUp(client *vmwareclient.VMWareClient, result motadatatypes.MotadataMap, conn net.Conn) {

	if r := recover(); r != nil {

		result[consts.Errors] = []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{
			{
				consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeInternalError,
				consts.Message:   "Invalid Result",
				consts.Error:     fmt.Sprintf("%v", r),
			},
		}
	}

	client.Destroy()

	err := conn.Close()

	if err != nil {

		result[consts.Errors] = []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{
			{
				consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeInternalError,
				consts.Error:     err.Error(),
			},
		}
	}
}

func run(result MotadataMap, context MotadataMap) {

	result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusFail

	var errors []MotadataStringMap

	batchSize := 1000

	port := 515 // Default UDP log listener port

	eventSource := fmt.Sprintf("%-15s", context.GetStringValue(consts.ObjectIP))

	if context.Contains(consts.RunbookPluginVariables) {

		variables := context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables)

		if variables.Contains("udp.port") {

			port = variables.GetIntValue("udp.port")
		}

		if variables.Contains("batch.size") {

			batchSize = variables.GetIntValue("batch.size")
		}
	}

	socket, err := net.Dial("udp", "127.0.0.1:"+strconv.Itoa(port))

	if err == nil {

		httpClient := &httpclient.HTTPClient{}

		defer cleanUp(httpClient, result, socket)

		httpClient.SetContext(context, &loggerObj)

		httpClient.SetURL(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf(tokenURL, context.GetStringValue(consts.ObjectIP))))

		httpClient.SetBodyAsMap(MotadataMap{

			"aaaUser": MotadataMap{

				"attributes": MotadataMap{

					"name": context.GetStringValue(consts.UserName),
					"pwd":  context.GetStringValue(consts.Password),
				},
			},
		})

		response := httpClient.ExecutePOSTRequest()

		if response.GetMapValue(httpclient.URLResponseContent).IsNotEmpty() {

			if response.GetINTValue(httpclient.URLResponseCode) == httpclient.URLResponseCodeSuccess {

				output := response.GetMapValue(httpclient.URLResponseContent)

				cookieToken := ToMap(output.GetSliceValue("imdata")[0]).GetMapValue("aaaLogin").GetMapValue("attributes").GetStringValue("token")

				httpClient.SetHeaders(MotadataMap{

					"Cookie": "APIC-cookie=" + cookieToken,
				})

				httpClient.SetURL(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf(faultRecordsURL, context.GetStringValue(consts.ObjectIP), 0, batchSize)))

				response = httpClient.ExecuteGETRequest()

				output = response.GetMapValue(httpclient.URLResponseContent)

				loggerObj.Info(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("Available Logs -> %s", output.GetStringValue("totalCount"))))

				for _, value := range output.GetSliceValue("imdata") {

					item := ToMap(value)

					item = item.GetMapValue("faultRecord").GetMapValue("attributes")

					if item.IsNotEmpty() {

						_, err = socket.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", eventSource, item.ToJSON())))
					}
				}

				collect := true

				for i := 1; collect; i++ {

					httpClient.SetURL(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf(faultRecordsURL, context.GetStringValue(consts.ObjectIP), i, batchSize)))

					response = httpClient.ExecuteGETRequest()

					output = response.GetMapValue(httpclient.URLResponseContent)

					if len(output.GetSliceValue("imdata")) > 0 {

						loggerObj.Info(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("sending fault records.. page: %d", i)))

						for _, value := range output.GetSliceValue("imdata") {

							item = item.GetMapValue("faultRecord").GetMapValue("attributes")

							if item.IsNotEmpty() {

								_, err = socket.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", eventSource, item.ToJSON())))
							}
						}

					} else {

						loggerObj.Info(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("No data found on page: %d", i)))

						collect = false

						result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusSucceed
					}
				}

				loggerObj.Warn(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("Response code: %d", response.GetINTValue(httpclient.URLResponseCode))))

	}
